applicant.name: Dr. Rosa Lehner
applicant.organisation: Hospital quality office, regional health fund

purpose: Policy-making: comparing the case mix of inpatient wards between hospitals.
question: In 2025, how many inpatient stays had heart failure, how many pneumonia and how many a hip fracture as main diagnosis, in each hospital?
definitions: Inpatient stay = encounter with type 'inpatient'; the main diagnosis is primary_icd10.
Heart failure = I50, pneumonia = J18, hip fracture = S72 (ICD-10 prefixes).
Count stays whose start_date is in 2025, per hospital (data holder of the stay).
Report per hospital: heart failure stays, pneumonia stays and hip fracture stays.
